notes.title: Ver1.0.7 Update Notice
notes.content:
Revisions
・Fixed an issue where repeatedly pressing the time stop button would cause the firing interval to become unintended.

notes.title: Ver1.0.6 Update Notice
notes.content:
Revisions
・When the game is reset, Ryoma Sakamoto will now be invincible.
┗This change was made because he was behaving unexpectedly when hit during a reset.


Known Issues
・There may be cases where the actual best time differs from the best time displayed on the stage selection screen.

notes.title: Ver1.0.5 Update Notice
notes.content:
∙ Added a “Buy Lotion Samurai!” button to the Extra Stage selection screen. button has been added to the Extra Stage selection screen.  
・Fixed a bug in the Extra Stage selection screen where the position of the button was sometimes in an unintended location.
Fixed a problem in which the previous display remained when switching rankings.

notes.title: Ver1.0.4 Update Notice
notes.content: Fixed a bug in 3-3 and EX-2 that caused unintended behavior when resetting at the moment of stage change.

notes.title: Ver1.0.3 Update Notice
notes.content: The pain perception of Ryoma Sakamoto was about 3 times bigger than the original, so it has been corrected.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.2 Update Notice
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented players from warping when resetting at the timing of stage change in 3-3 and EX-2.
Fixed a problem in which pressing the back button when the cursor is over “BGM” or “SE” in the options screen would cause the game to become inoperable.
Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from moving after a reset.
Fixed an issue where the time stop gauge would not recover when stepping on a magic circle in rare cases.
Fixed a problem in which a player's glaze judgment would become misaligned as the game continued.
